# AddGadgetItem

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

```blitzbasic
AddGadgetItem gadget%, item$, select%=0, icon%=-1
```

**Works in:** BlitzPlus

Adds an entry at the end of a list box, combo box or tabber. For a tabber the entry is a new tab. Use [InsertGadgetItem](InsertGadgetItem) to put it somewhere else.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("List", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
list = CreateListBox(10, 10, 200, 120, win)
AddGadgetItem list, "Apples"
AddGadgetItem list, "Pears"
AddGadgetItem list, "Plums", True
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```

![AddGadgetItem](media/gadgets/addgadgetitem.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | Int | required | Handle of a list box, combo box or tabber. |
| `item` | String | required |  |
| `select` | Int | `0` | True makes it the selected entry. Defaults to False. |
| `icon` | Int | `-1` | Number of an icon in the icon strip given with [SetGadgetIconStrip](SetGadgetIconStrip). Defaults to -1, which means none. |
